en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Muhammad Bin Hafs, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from one of the two (5<sup>th</sup> or 6<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) having said:

‘Wergild of the greyhound dog is forty Dirhams, Rasool-Allahsaww made it to be that, and wergild of the shepherd dog, and the wergild of the plantation guard dog being a ‘Jareyb’ (unit of measurement) from the wheat; and wergild of domesticated dog being a ‘Qafeez’ (Unit of measurement) from the soil of its owners’.
